claims.statement: The token endpoint returns a refresh_token that is exchanged for a new access token; the authentication guide says refresh tokens cannot access protected APIs and each can only be used once.

sources.supports: refresh_token string The token that you can use to refresh the access token.
Each refresh token can only be used once. A successful response from the endpoint includes a new access token, the expiry time for the new token, and another refresh token.
